commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Carl Starfelt and he is replaced by Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
88' Substitution. Damian Rodriguez did his best and is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
88' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) replacing Unai Nunez.
88' Substitution. Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) on for Jonathan Bamba.
88' Jailson (Celta Vigo) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
84' 1 - 0 Goal! Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the right post. It's 1:0.
84' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

84' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Vicente Guaita makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

82' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
82' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
81' Vicente Guaita displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
80' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vicente Guaita, who smothers the ball.
79' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
78' A precise low pass is received by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
78' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.

77' The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick. The ball is crossed into the box and Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the roof of the net, but Vicente Guaita gets a glove on it to thwart him.
77' An attempted cross from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.

76' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Vicente Guaita makes a great save to stop his effort. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
75' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.

75' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
75' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) replaces Antoine Griezmann.
75' Substitution. Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Rodrigo Riquelme walks off.

74' What a chance that is! Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post!
73' Half-chance! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) plays a pass into the box, but Jan Oblak reacts well to snuff out the attack.
72' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
69' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
68' Substitution. Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) in, Jorgen Strand Larsen out.
67' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Jan Oblak was alert and made a comfortable save.
67' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Koke (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez saw the whole situation.
64' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atl. Madrid was in an offside position.
64' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
63' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
62' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Angel Correa will be replaced by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
60' One of the players from Atl. Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
59' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the roof of the net. Jan Oblak is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Stefan Savic as he is replaced by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid).
55' Vicente Guaita displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
54' The corner kick from Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
52' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
49' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) will not participate anymore and Alvaro Morata is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) sends it out of play.

45+2' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' A cross into the box from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
41' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

40' He should have scored! Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Vicente Guaita makes an easy save.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
34' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.
32' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
31' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.

31' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
29' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
27' Vicente Guaita displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
26' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
25' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
24' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.

23' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Celta Vigo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
22' That's unlucky! Koke (Atl. Madrid) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
21' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
19' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
18' The free kick is taken by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), but ball is cleared.

17' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Atl. Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
14' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Vicente Guaita is alert and denies him.

14' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Vicente Guaita anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
14' The ball possession at the moment is 59:41.
12' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
10' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
8' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
7' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul.
5' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots low towards goal, but Vicente Guaita makes a magnificent save!
2' Jailson (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.
1' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
